fact: The Ministry of Health and Sanitation reports it launched a Health Information Hub, described as fully functional, that integrates data from multiple platforms including DHIS2 and consolidates facility, human resources, supply chain and referral data.

Atlantic Infos reports that WAHO opened a five-day regional workshop in Cotonou to pilot automated transfer of routine health data from national DHIS2 systems, with Sierra Leone one of four pilot countries.
system: WAHO automated routine health data sharing (DHIS2)
